# A hanging banner (generated by make_env.py): 1.2 x 3.0 m, a swallowtail, a dark stripe, on a rod.
# Faces +Z (the hall); origin at the rod's centre.
new
material new Cloth --base-color 0.5137 0.2745 0.3922 --no-slot
material new Stripe --base-color 0.3490 0.1882 0.5176 --no-slot
material new Rod --base-color 0.1490 0.1255 0.1137 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Rod --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 0.000
scale 1.600 0.160 0.160
apply --scale
material assign Rod
add mesh cube --name Cloth --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.000 -1.340
scale 1.200 0.080 2.520
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
active Cloth
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cube --name Stripe --size 1 --location 0.000 -0.025 -0.600
scale 1.200 0.130 0.300
apply --scale
material assign Stripe
active Stripe
mode edit
select face where "normal.y > 0.5"
delete face
mode object
add mesh cone --name TailL --vertices 3 --radius1 0.34 --radius2 0 --depth 0.08 --location -0.300 0.000 -2.600
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 180 0
apply --rotation
scale 0.88 1 1.4
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
add mesh cone --name TailR --vertices 3 --radius1 0.34 --radius2 0 --depth 0.08 --location 0.300 0.000 -2.600
set rotation 90 0 0
apply --rotation
set rotation 0 180 0
apply --rotation
scale 0.88 1 1.4
apply --scale
material assign Cloth
select all
shade flat
export banner.glb
